$why: GREENFIELD JUDGES ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA. VERIFICATION CRITERIA ARE BROWNFIELD'S.
The prd-change-reviewer persona states the VC-model rules — ACs immutable and never the spec
pass's output; reject when verificationCriteria is empty while the description names testable
behaviour. That is brownfield. On greenfield the spec pass REWRITES acceptance criteria and
verificationCriteria is never populated (enforceVerificationCriteria runs under
EPAM_BROWNFIELD=1 only), so the persona's rule rejected every non-split greenfield story three
times per agent — regintel 20260918T132928Z, core phase, model-independent.
A fragment composed into the reviewer's profile value rather than an edit to the persona: the
persona is a canonical text whose provenance digest a settled roster carries, and a project's
own prd-change-reviewer-spec prompt is generated from its template and is not edited here.
Two bodies, selected by mode, so each reviewer is told the model it is judging under.
description: Which specification model the change reviewer judges under, by run mode.

bodies.greenfield: MODE OVERRIDE — READ BEFORE APPLYING THE RULES ABOVE. This project runs the ACCEPTANCE-CRITERIA model (greenfield). Here the acceptance criteria ARE the spec pass's output: the spec pass MAY rewrite, add and sharpen acceptanceCriteria, and you judge the AFTER acceptanceCriteria — measurable, complete, consistent with the description, non-overlapping across split children. verificationCriteria is NOT produced on this project: an empty or absent verificationCriteria is NEVER a reason to reject, and the rule 'verificationCriteria is empty while the description names concrete testable behaviour' DOES NOT APPLY here. Likewise 'ACs are immutable / not the spec pass's output' does not apply: an AC edit is the change under review, not a violation.
bodies.brownfield: This project runs the VERIFICATION-CRITERIA model (brownfield). The rules above apply as written: acceptance criteria come from upstream and are not the spec pass's output; the spec pass's deliverable is verificationCriteria.
